name: kanvibe
description: AI agent task management Kanban board with embedded SQLite desktop packaging.
author: rookedsysc

scripts.dist: pnpm db:prepare && pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:native:electron && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm db:prepare && pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:native:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm --dir docs-site install && pnpm --dir docs-site dev
scripts.docs:build: pnpm --dir docs-site install && pnpm --dir docs-site build
scripts.docs:start: pnpm --dir docs-site install && pnpm --dir docs-site start
scripts.test:e2e:login: bash -lc 'for port in 4884 4885; do fuser -k "$port"/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; done; rm -f .next/dev/lock; playwright test tests/e2e/login.spec.js'
scripts.qa:move-autocomplete: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/__tests__/Board.test.tsx -t "자동 완성" && bash scripts/qa-move-autocomplete-video.sh
scripts.qa:task-kind-filter: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/__tests__/Board.test.tsx src/desktop/renderer/hooks/__tests__/useTaskKindFilterParams.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-task-kind-filter-video.sh
scripts.qa:terminal-tab: pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/__tests__/terminalTabs.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/terminalSessionLifecycle.test.ts src/desktop/main/services/__tests__/terminalTabService.test.ts src/desktop/renderer/components/__tests__/TerminalTabBar.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-electron-flow-video.sh terminal-tab
scripts.qa:project-registry-search: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/__tests__/ProjectRegistryDialog.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/ProjectSelector.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-electron-flow-video.sh project-registry-search
scripts.qa:terminal-task-context-badge: pnpm exec vitest run src/desktop/renderer/routes/__tests__/TaskDetailRoute.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/ProjectIcon.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-electron-flow-video.sh terminal-task-context-badge
scripts.qa:ai-session-history: pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/aiSessions && pnpm exec vitest run src/desktop/renderer/routes/__tests__/TaskDetailRoute.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-ai-session-history-video.sh
scripts.qa:live-ai-sessions: pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/aiSessions src/desktop/renderer/components/__tests__/LiveAiSessionPanel.test.tsx src/desktop/renderer/components/__tests__/AgentCallGraphPanel.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/TaskCardLiveSessions.test.tsx && bash scripts/qa-electron-flow-video.sh live-ai-sessions
scripts.qa:ai-usage: pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/aiUsage src/desktop/main/services/__tests__/aiUsageService.test.ts src/desktop/renderer/hooks/__tests__/useAiUsage.test.ts src/desktop/renderer/components/__tests__/AiUsagePanel.test.tsx src/desktop/renderer/routes/__tests__/TaskDetailRoute.test.tsx src/desktop/renderer/utils/__tests__/keyboardShortcut.test.ts src/desktop/main/__tests__/desktopShortcutRouting.test.ts && bash scripts/qa-electron-flow-video.sh ai-usage
